name: State of California
disclaimer: This data reflects California law as understood in early 2024. Local ordinances and state law change frequently. Always verify with the applicable building department and a licensed design professional before relying on these values for permit submission.

notes: Owner occupancy requirement removed through Jan 1 2030 by AB 976 (2023).
Height may be 18 ft if within 1/2 mile of a major transit stop per SB 897.
Garage conversion ADUs keep existing structure setbacks; no new setback required.
Solar PV system required per Title 24 2022 Part 6 §150.1(c)14; small ADU exceptions may apply.
Impact fees are waived for ADUs 750 sq ft or smaller per CA Gov Code §65852.2(f)(2).

attached.max_height_note: Attached ADU may match primary dwelling height; consult local ordinance for cap.
notes: Floor area may not exceed 50% of primary dwelling or 1,200 sq ft, whichever is less.
Setbacks match detached; existing wall may not require additional setback.

garage_conversion.setback_note: Existing structure setbacks apply; no new setback required for conversion.
notes: Replacement parking spaces are NOT required when garage is converted to ADU (SB 9 / AB 2221).
Existing non-conforming setbacks may be maintained.
Interior conversion: may not require full ADU setbacks from property line.

citations.setback_note: CA Gov Code §65852.2(a)(4)(B) — existing structure setbacks apply

jadu.setback_note: JADU must be within or attached to existing or proposed primary dwelling; existing setbacks apply.
notes: JADU must be entirely within the existing or proposed primary dwelling or attached garage.
Owner must occupy EITHER the primary dwelling or the JADU.
JADU must have an efficiency kitchen with cooking appliance and sink.
Interior access between primary and JADU must exist (door may be lockable).
